mapper.select: SELECT b.region_code AS regionCode, CASE WHEN b.region_code = '02' THEN '서울' WHEN b.region_code = '031' THEN '경기' WHEN b.region_code = '032' THEN '인천' WHEN b.region_code = '033' THEN '강원' WHEN b.region_code = '041' THEN '충남' WHEN b.region_code = '042' THEN '대전' WHEN b.region_code = '043' THEN '충북' WHEN b.region_code = '044' THEN '세종' WHEN b.region_code = '051' THEN '부산' WHEN b.region_code = '052' THEN '울산' WHEN b.region_code = '053' THEN '대구' WHEN b.region_code = '054' THEN '경북' WHEN b.region_code = '055' THEN '경남' WHEN b.region_code = '061' THEN '전남' WHEN b.region_code = '062' THEN '광주' WHEN b.region_code = '063' THEN '전북' WHEN b.region_code = '064' THEN '제주' ELSE '기타' END AS regionName, ROUND(AVG(p.composite_score), 2) AS avgCompositeScore, ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.claim_count AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS avgClaimCount, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS avgRevenueGrowth, ROUND(AVG(p.hygiene_score), 2) AS avgHygieneScore, ROUND(AVG(p.customer_score), 2) AS avgCustomerScore FROM branches_51 b JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON b.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE b.operating_status = 'OPERATING' GROUP BY b.region_code ORDER BY b.region_code
